thread:
sophie: Heads-up — partner hit a hard block on marketplace listing. Procurement says they won't accept our PO because billing entity doesn't match their vendor record. PO already issued but portal rejected. PO# 2026-ACME-8812. Need legal on redline + billing entity fix. @maria-legal can you take a look? :eyes:

sam-partnerships: Ugh. They attached a marked-up MSA where they reinserted an indemnity paragraph we removed earlier. Also the portal screenshot shows "billing entity mismatch" error. Link: https://acme.portal/screenshot.png

maria-legal: I can do a quick review. Which clause did they re-add? If it's a broad indemnity we push back. Also finance needs to confirm whether we can accept an alias for the billing entity. @kevin-finance?

kevin-finance: Confirmed: vendor record = "ACME Solutions US, Inc." but PO lists "ACME Cloud LLC". Marketplace automated settlement requires exact match. Options: reissue PO with the canonical name (fastest if partner procurement will do it) or create an alias mapping in the marketplace console (requires partner support ticket + affidavit). Reissue PO is typically faster by 24-72h if partner can act.

jordan-sales: Partner procurement says they have a freeze and can’t reissue easily this week. They asked if we can map alias on our side. I tried marketplace support but the queue is slow.

sophie: Also partner labeled clause 6.2 indemnity as "non-negotiable" in their redline. If we accept we take more risk. Any chance we can accept a limited carveout scoped to marketplace listing?

maria-legal: Send me their redline PDF. If indemnity is vendor-favored and broad, we should propose a carveout limiting it to breaches tied to partner-provided assets. I'll draft a tracked-change proposal.

sam-partnerships: FYI they opened ticket with marketplace partner-support: ticket #675432. Support ETA 48h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

eva-ops: ops-bot: I pushed a temporary alias to staging for validation only. This is a non-prod workaround to confirm settlement flow; not for production. Snippet:
```
alias_map = {"ACME Cloud LLC": "ACME Solutions US, Inc."}
apply_alias('marketplace', alias_map)
```

kevin-finance: Note: if we go alias route finance requires a signed affidavit from partner confirming tax ID and entity linkage. That typically adds 3-5 business days.

jordan-sales: Customer wants to close this week. Any accelerated playbooks?

maria-legal: Two accelerated options: (1) request partner reissue PO + expedite via their procurement exec (best and clean), (2) accept temp alias + get affidavit via sales as a stopgap (risky). I'll prepare a lean redline reply that limits indemnity exposure and propose a short SOW carveout for marketplace activity. Send me the partner redlines now.

sophie: I'm pinging partner exec and asking for PO reissue + expedited approvals. @jordan-sales can you push with your exec sponsor?

jordan-sales: On it — looping in partner procurement lead now and cc'ing their legal.

ops-bot: Incident created: marketplace-listing-blocker PRD-3142 — assigned to partnerships. SLA timer started.

sam-partnerships: Next steps recap: 1) Sophie escalate for PO reissue, 2) Maria draft limited indemnity carveout and reply to partner redlines, 3) Kevin confirm affidavit timeline if alias chosen, 4) Eva/ops maintain staging alias for acceptance testing, 5) Jordan escalate with partner exec to try to reissue PO.

sophie: Thanks — will update once partner responds. :pray:
